reference_character_images.title: Reference Character Images
reference_character_images.description: Upload character reference images as identity-critical anchors. Generated people must preserve the same face likeness, facial proportions, age impression, skin tone, hairline, hair length, hair part, hair volume/style, distinctive marks, wardrobe, and styling continuity rather than using a generic model face. For 3x3 storyboards, include the referenced person in some frames and require every intentional person frame to show a clear visible referenced face. When identity cannot be preserved confidently, prefer product-only, hands-only, over-shoulder, back-of-head, partial-face crop, or detail shots instead of inventing a different face. Use as clear face identity anchors for recurring people; preserve the same face and avoid waxy, plastic, CG-looking, blurred, cropped, or identity-swapped characters across shots.

reference_product_images.title: Reference Product Images
reference_product_images.description: Upload product reference images. These are the highest-priority truth source and color-critical anchors. The generated storyboard must preserve the exact product form, cross-section shape, roundness/flat-sidedness, height-to-width ratio, cap-to-body ratio, material, package color, cap/lid color, branding, label hierarchy, visible text, and key details. Cinematic style, warm lighting, spa/luxury mood, and environment palette must not recolor a white/translucent product into amber/brown glass, gold lids, beige/pink/champagne tint, or any alternate premium colorway. Treat these images as immutable product evidence; never add, remove, stretch, reshape, recolor, re-texture, relabel, simplify, or redesign the product.

product_label_text.title: Product Label Text
product_label_text.description: Optional but strongly recommended when label accuracy matters. Enter the exact visible product/package text that must be preserved, one line per label line. Include brand spelling, trademark marks, formula/product name, secondary lines, Korean/Thai/Japanese/Chinese/English text, weight/volume, badges, seals, and important stickers. If left blank, the skill must OCR/transcribe the clearest product reference image and include a VISIBLE LABEL TEXT TO PRESERVE block.

image_text_mode.title: Visible Text In Image
image_text_mode.description: Controls whether the generated image may include added visible text such as captions, callouts, infographic labels, headlines, frame numbers, or measurement text. Default is no added text for non-infographic styles. Info Graphics Realistic and Info Graphics override this default and require concise large visible infographic text. Product packaging text, logos, and markings from the reference product are preserved separately and do not count as added text.

cinematic_style.title: Cinematic Style
cinematic_style.description: Choose the visual style for the storyboard. Style affects scene, lighting, camera, and mood only; it must not change the referenced product colors, cap/lid color, package material, logo, or label text. Warm or luxury styles may affect the room but must not tint or recolor the product packaging. Info Graphics Realistic and Info Graphics intentionally create text-forward infographic layouts with large concise readable text; they override the no-text default while still preserving the referenced product. Default storyboard prompts should favor cinematic photorealistic product-film quality with dimensional lighting, realistic lens/depth, and camera choices that match Storyboard Guide plus Voiceover Script; style must not change product geometry, material, labels, colorway, scale, or character identity.

storyboard_guide.title: Storyboard Guide
storyboard_guide.description: Optional storyboard, shot brief, or video-shot guide from Media Studio. When provided, every generated frame prompt must follow this guide's shot order, timing, story beat, action, camera intent, product-use intent, and continuity. The guide is a creative direction contract; do not contradict it. If left blank, keep the normal skill behavior.

voiceover_script.title: Voiceover Script / Dialogue
voiceover_script.description: Optional spoken dialogue, narration, or voiceover script from Media Studio. Use this together with Storyboard Guide as the primary shot-by-shot content source. Match each numbered/timed spoken line to the corresponding guide beat; parse shot markers even if whitespace is collapsed. Do not invent a different visual story. Product Detail / Product Facts and reference images still lock the real product, claims, scale, labels, character, and environment fidelity.

production_concept_details.title: Product Detail / Product Facts
production_concept_details.description: Optional product details, product facts, selected concept context, and claim-safety notes from Media Studio. Use this to lock real product truth such as product type, model, size, countable parts, material, color, scale, use case, audience problem, hook, and selling points while preserving all reference-image locks. Do not introduce price, rating, sales volume, promotions, or other volatile marketplace claims.
